lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spots to form a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient between highlight and shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notches on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin; presence of multiple remoras attached ventrally near the pectoral fin base.
